positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
-Work with Business Analyst to review release content/schedule
-Ensure team members are meeting deadlines

positions.title: Consultant II
positions.description:
-Full stack Java consultant on a traditional Scrum team (Senior role) responsible for maintaining and adding new functionality to existing software. On occasion, responsibilities for this team included regression and end-to-end testing.

-Facilitate monthly team meetings providing colleagues opportunity to showcase skills as well as grow professionally.

-Member of the Interview team

projects.title: Positive Maturity
projects.description:
-Designed, developed, tested, and deployed a desktop application
(Java/MySQL) with a database backend that store that information of senior
assistance agencies in the Alabama area. Worked in collaboration with the
Executive Director and assigned Project Manager to create a product that
suited the company’s needs. 
-Scheduled increment update meetings were held to disclose project details and answer questions.
